_readme: Copy this file to seed/events.json and replace it with your real events.
seed/events.json is gitignored on purpose: your events, partners, and the
people who came are your data, never application code (PRD guardrail 6).
ownerUid is the host UID that owns these events. It must be in hp_config/allowlist.
sourceKey is the stable slug an already-happened event is known by, and it is
what hp_people registrations join on. Use the same slug the guest export was
filed under, or the seeder cannot connect the guest list to the event.
parties name orgs by the exact name they carry in hp_orgs. A party whose org
is not seeded yet is skipped with a warning rather than half written.
